jobs_results.title: Data Business Analyst - (DataBricks, SAP, Azure) (Bengaluru)
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst / Data Business Analyst with strong expertise across SAP and Non-SAP data environments, data modelling, data quality, and cloud-based data platforms. The role will work closely with Business, IT, Functional, Technical, and Data Engineering teams to translate business requirements into high-quality data products.

Key Responsibilities

- Translate business requirements into technical specifications for Data Engineers and support the development of data products.
- Define, establish, and validate data quality standards across ETL processes, systems, and data products.
- Collaborate with Business, IT Functional, Technical, and Data Engineering teams to deliver scalable data solutions.
- Analyze complex SAP and Non-SAP datasets to support data modelling, transformation, and analytics requirements.
- Develop and validate data mappings, ensuring accuracy, completeness, consistency, and adherence to data quality standards.
- Verify the correctness and usability of data products across various business and technical requirements.
- Develop data collection, transformation, and automation workflows using cloud services and analytics tools.
- Analyze large and complex datasets to generate meaningful business insights and recommendations.
- Develop and support analytical dashboards and reporting solutions using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
- Work with stakeholders to translate technical data concepts into clear business insights and actionable outcomes.
- Mentor junior analysts on data analysis, data modelling, analytics best practices, and coding standards.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of data processes, governance, quality, and analytics capabilities.

Required Skills & Experience

- Professional experience in Data Analysis / Business Analysis with demonstrated expertise in both SAP and Non-SAP environments.
- Strong understanding of data modelling, data mapping, ETL processes, and data quality.
- Hands-on or working knowledge of SQL, Python, or R.
- Exposure to Microsoft Azure services, particularly Azure Data Factory (ADF), Databricks, and related cloud data services.
- Strong experience with analytical and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
- Ability to work with large and complex datasets and derive meaningful business insights.
- Robust analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and technical concepts into business language.
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Statistics, Business, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Good to Have

- Exposure to Machine Learning, AI, and advanced predictive analytics.
- Familiarity with Azure-based cloud data platforms and modern data architecture.
- Understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality frameworks, metadata, and data standards.
- Experience in validating data products against governance, quality, and compliance requirements.
- Experience in the Manufacturing industry in roles such as Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Data Consultant.
- Experience working with SAP data, business processes, and manufacturing-related datasets.
- Exposure to modern data platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, and cloud analytics ecosystems. .

jobs_results.title: Business Analyst (NIT or IIT)
jobs_results.description:
Location:** HSR Layout, Bangalore | **Work Mode:
On-site


#### Experience:
1–3 years


#### Education:
Graduates from IIT, BITS,IIIT or NIT preferred


#### About Propelld


Propelld is a leading fintech NBFC transforming the education financing landscape. We leverage **data-driven insights and cutting-edge technology** to optimize financial solutions and enable better business decisions.

We are looking for a **Business Analyst** to join our team and work on high-impact analytical projects in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

### Key Responsibilities


- Extract, analyze, and interpret complex datasets to generate actionable business insights.

- Develop, optimize, and maintain **SQL queries** for data retrieval, transformation, and analysis.

- Utilize **Python** for data manipulation, automation, analysis, and data-driven modelling.

- Build insightful **reports and dashboards** using Excel and relevant visualization tools.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and implement data-backed solutions.

- Identify **trends, correlations, patterns, and opportunities** to support business performance and decision-making.

- Translate business requirements into structured analytical problems and actionable insights.

- Support stakeholders with accurate and timely analysis for business and operational decisions.

### Key Requirements


- **1–3 years of hands-on experience** in business/data analysis or a related analytical role.

- Strong proficiency in **SQL**, including querying, data extraction, joins, aggregations, and data transformation.

- Strong working knowledge of **Python** for data manipulation, analysis, and automation.

- Proficiency in **Excel**, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP and data visualization.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with large and complex datasets.

- Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on data accuracy.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to present and explain complex insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

- Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and understand business requirements.

### Preferred Educational Background


Graduates from **IIT, BITS, IIIT or NIT** are preferred. Candidates from other strong quantitative or technical backgrounds with relevant hands-on experience in **SQL, Python, Excel, and analytics** may also be considered.

### Life at Propelld


- Competitive salary and performance-driven growth opportunities.

- Flexible working environment.

- Comprehensive healthcare coverage for employees and their dependents.

- Recognition and rewards for employee contributions and achievements.

- Thoughtfully designed holiday and leave policies to support work-life balance.

- Learning and development opportunities to help employees build skills aligned with current and future industry standards.

- A vibrant workplace with great food, games, and an engaging office environment.

If you enjoy solving business problems through data and turning insights into action, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs_results.title: Business Analyst – Freshers Only
jobs_results.description:
*We’re Hiring | Business Analyst – Freshers Only*

At *Haus Of Brands*, we help restaurant brands grow their online business across Swiggy, Zomato, Ownly, Toing, and other delivery platforms.

We’re looking for a *Business Analyst* who is curious about numbers, comfortable working with people, and keen to understand what makes a business grow.

*What you’ll do:*

•⁠ ⁠Track sales, customer funnels, ratings, reviews, and performance across multiple restaurant brands

•⁠ ⁠Analyze platform data to identify trends, understand issues, and highlight growth opportunities

•⁠ ⁠Support brand level P&L analysis to understand how sales, discounts, and costs affect profitability

•⁠ ⁠Compare performance across outlets and platforms to understand what’s working, what’s falling behind, and why

•⁠ ⁠Maintain dashboards, performance reports, and action trackers that help the team make decisions

•⁠ ⁠Study customer feedback, ordering patterns, and menu performance to recommend improvements

•⁠ ⁠Work closely with Growth Managers to explain your findings, recommend next steps, and track whether those actions improve results

Who we’re looking for:

•⁠ ⁠Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 6 months of internship experience

•⁠ ⁠Good working knowledge of *Excel and Google Sheets*

•⁠ ⁠Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail

•⁠ ⁠Clear communication and the confidence to ask questions, share an opinion, and explain your findings

•⁠ ⁠Someone who takes ownership, follows through, and is eager to learn

You’ll get hands on exposure to how restaurant businesses operate and grow online from understanding performance to helping the team decide what to do next.

*📍 Koramangala, Bengaluru | Work From Office | Monday – Friday*

Being based nearby helps, but being able to commute reliably matters most.

📩 Send your CV to [REDACTED EMAIL] and [REDACTED EMAIL], or DM us on LinkedIn.
